findings.evidence: The docstrings explicitly say exposure supports downstream checks; `relators` already has only length/membership lemmas, while `relatorLetters` and `totalLength` have no defining API at all.
findings.fix: Seal these bodies and provide public constructor equations/`*_def` lemmas, appropriately marked `@[simp]`, then prove the audit results through that characteristic API.
findings.issue: `Relator.toWord` is `@[expose]` solely to make downstream audits reduce; the same over-exposure occurs for `GroupPresentation.relators`, `relatorLetters`, and `totalLength` at lines 82, 103, and 114 of `GroupPresentation.lean`.

findings.evidence: `rg` finds every use of all four names only in `Mathieu.lean`, while the module documentation advertises them as main public definitions.
findings.fix: Make all four helpers local/private; if a reusable two-generator alphabet is intended, move a properly named abstraction to the general presentation module instead of exporting it from `Sporadic.Mathieu`.
findings.issue: `genA`, `invA`, `genB`, and `invB` are exported from `TauCeti.Sporadic` although they are merely notation helpers used only to build this file’s three presentations.

summary: The PR exposes implementation bodies for audit computation and exports file-local alphabet helpers, unnecessarily enlarging the canonical API.
